entry.title: Knowember 2026 (#blogPost)
entry.summary:
I discovered Robert's knowember page and thing it's a lovely idea. So here we go! A photo
This year I discovered a new love for long distance cycling and participated in multiple 200km+ events. The photo was taken on the way to this year's Berlin bike marathon. If you're into video bike content, here's the tour of me and my friends on YouTube. Where in the world I blog from
I'm based in Berlin, Germany. I've been living here for almost twenty years and don't see myself living anywhere else. What my blog is mostly about
This blog used to be heavily focused on tech and Frontend topics but with the current changes in the industry I might open it up for any topic I feel like writing about. And that's it. Short and sweet. As mentioned above, Robert’s responsible for Knowember and you can check more posts on his site.
